sn22.65:1.2: Then a certain bhikkhu approached the Blessed One … and said to him:
sn22.65:1.3: “Venerable sir, it would be good if the Blessed One would teach me the Dhamma in brief….”
sn22.65:1.4: “Bhikkhu, in seeking delight one is bound by Mara;
sn22.65:1.5: by not seeking delight one is freed from the Evil One.”
sn22.65:2.1: “In what way, bhikkhu, do you understand in detail the meaning of what was stated by me in brief?”
sn22.65:2.2: “In seeking delight in form, venerable sir, one is bound by Mara;
sn22.65:2.3: by not seeking delight in it one is freed from the Evil One.
sn22.65:2.7: in consciousness one is bound by Mara;
sn22.65:2.8: by not seeking delight in it one is freed from the Evil One.
sn22.65:2.9: “It is in such a way, venerable sir, that I understand in detail the meaning of what was stated by the Blessed One in brief.”
sn22.65:3.2: It is good that you understand in detail the meaning of what was stated by me in brief.
sn22.65:3.3: In seeking delight in form, bhikkhu, one is bound by Mara …
sn22.65:3.9: by not seeking delight in it one is freed from the Evil One.
sn22.65:3.10: It is in such a way that the meaning of what was stated by me in brief should be understood in detail.”
sn22.65:3.11: … And that bhikkhu became one of the arahants.
